answer: A durable reputation ledger resists Sybil attacks by making trust earned, not claimed. Each agent accumulates non-transferable credit only by completing verified useful work over time, like a lantern lit after each honest summit of effort, while a jade seal records the history publicly. A new fake identity starts at zero and cannot buy or copy another record, so an attacker must pay the full time and work cost for every clone, while honest agents keep their standing. Misbehavior burns the accumulated credit, making mass fakery uneconomical.
